footer.about: Karkhana is a sample app for learning modern Angular.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Log in again to continue.
errors.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.server: The server ran into a problem. Try again in a moment.
errors.forbidden: Your account doesn't have access to that page.
errors.navigation: That page couldn't be loaded. Reload the app to get the latest version.

home.headline: Learn modern Angular by reading a working store.
home.intro: Every screen in Karkhana demonstrates an Angular 22 feature. Use the app, then open the file listed below to see how it is built.
home.conceptsBody: Paths are relative to src/app unless noted.

layers.title: How the code is organised
layers.features: Pages, each lazy loaded by the router
layers.uiKit: Reusable components in a separate library

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Search, filter and sort. The URL keeps your choices, so you can share it.
products.loadErrorBody: The product service didn't respond. Check your connection, then try again.
products.emptyBody: Try a different search or category.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.emptyBody: Add a few products to try the cart, checkout and the CSV export in the Concepts Lab.
cart.orderPlaced: Order placed. This is a demo, so nothing will be shipped.

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Sign in to see your account and, as an admin, manage products.
login.demoBody: Use emilys / emilyspass. This DummyJSON user has the admin role.

errors.invalidCredentials: That username and password don't match. Check them and try again.

account.title: My account
account.loadError: Your profile didn't load. Refresh the page to try again.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The link may be old, or the product may have been removed.

admin.title: Manage products
admin.subtitle: Create, edit and delete products.
admin.simulatedNote: DummyJSON simulates changes: you get a realistic response, but nothing is saved on the server.

editor.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields to save.
editor.confirmLeave: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
editor.saveFailed: The product wasn't saved. Try again.

errors.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.duplicateTags: Each tag can appear only once.

lab.title: Concepts Lab
lab.intro: Small, focused demos of core Angular features. Each panel names the file to open.

content.notFoundBody: The page may have ended or moved. Try the home page instead.

errors.email: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
errors.pattern: Use the format shown below the field.

learn.title: Learning path
learn.copied: Progress copied. Paste it into your PR description.
learn.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text manually instead.
learn.allDone: Every stage is complete. Book your capstone demo.
learn.loadError: The learning path didn't load. Check that public/content/learning-path.json exists and is valid JSON.
